name: LABUBU/OLPC
rootCause: OLPC pair reserve manipulation. Lost: 1,115,903.66 USDT

descriptions.text: OLPC pair reserve manipulation. Lost: 1,115,903.66 USDT

The OLPC/LABUBU liquidity pool on PancakeSwap V2 (BNB Chain) was exploited, resulting in approximately $1.1 million in losses. The attacker exploited a logic vulnerability in the OLPC token contract’s _update function. Approximately 46 days prior, the OLPC owner had maliciously changed the decimalsValue parameter to an extremely large value (7326680472586200649) and later renounced ownership. A small OLPC transfer triggered massive burns of OLPC and LABUBU tokens from the pool (to the dead address), desynchronizing the pair’s cached reserves. This allowed the attacker to drain a large amount of LABUBU, which was swapped through intermediate pools for ~1.115 million USDT.…

LABUBU/OLPC's PancakeSwap V2 pool on BNB Chain was exploited on June 20, 2026, resulting in a $1.12M loss through a reserve mismatch triggered by OLPC's amplified burn mechanism, allowing the attacker to drain LABUBU at distorted prices. The OLPC token applied an amplified burn on pair-originated transfers, using an unbounded owner-set multiplier decimalsValue, which interacted destructively with PancakeSwap's public skim/sync mechanics, collapsing pool reserves and enabling the attacker to drain LABUBU at mispriced rates.
